sentences.en: It is regrettable that she should have died so young.
sentences.zh: 她这么年轻就去世真是遗憾。

sentences.en: I found it truly regrettable that he should take offence.
sentences.zh: 他竟然生气了，我感到非常遗憾。

sentences.en: It is regrettable that you did not start earlier.
sentences.zh: 你没有早点开始真是太遗憾了。

senses.zh: 令人遗憾的；可惜的；可悲的；抱歉的
